sloka: एते हि सचिवा राजन् तार प्रभृतयः तव ।पुर वासि जनः च अयम् परिवार्य विषीदति ॥४-२५-४६॥
transliteration: ete hi sacivā rājan tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tava ।pura vāsi janaḥ ca ayam parivārya viṣīdati ॥4-25-46॥

translations.english: 'O conqueror of enemies give these monkeys their due in accordance with their status and send them back as you used to do when they were passionately sporting in your company here in this forest.
